name: How do I ensure an operable skylight won't leak?
description: Leak prevention for operable skylights depends on precise installation, proper flashing, and regular maintenance checks of seals.

mainEntity.name: How do I ensure an operable skylight won't leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing leaks in an operable skylight relies heavily on precise installation and proper flashing. We use integrated flashing systems designed to channel water away from the skylight, coupled with thorough sealing techniques. Additionally, selecting a reputable installer with experience in varied roof types, like Hometelligent Inc. in the Alameda area, is crucial. Regular maintenance checks of the seals and flashing can further help identify and address potential issues before they lead to leaks.
